$comment: DTD (parsec/interfaces/dtd/insert_function.h) is a C API, not a language of its own. This injection grammar only adds the DTD names on top of the C and C++ highlighting. All the names carry the parsec_ / PARSEC_ prefix, so it is harmless in any other C file.
name: PaRSEC DTD (C/C++ injection)

patterns.$comment: The leading \s* makes the match start where the C++ grammar's own function-call rule starts, otherwise that rule wins the tie.
Access mode of an argument, then modifier flags that can be or-ed with it (PARSEC_INOUT | PARSEC_AFFINITY | PARSEC_PUSHOUT)
